description: This file contains an immutable implementation class 'ModifyFeaturesLiveCommandImpl' which implements the 'ModifyFeaturesLiveCommand' interface, extending functionality from 'AbstractModifyLiveCommand'. It handles modification commands related to features within the Eclipse Ditto framework, including factory methods, getters, and overrides specific to this command type.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the 'ModifyFeaturesLiveCommand' interface, providing functionality to modify features in a live context within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance from a Command object, casting it to ModifyFeatures.

methods.name: getFeatures
methods.description: Returns the features associated with this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category type, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command changes authorization (returns false).

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Provides a builder for generating responses to this command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides default toString to include class name and superclass info.
